* Janet's ducks lay 16 eggs per day
* Janet eats 3 eggs for breakfast every morning
* Janet bakes muffins with 4 eggs for her friends every day
* Janet sells the rest of the eggs at the market daily for $2 per egg.

Eggs remaining = Ducks laying eggs per day - Eggs eaten for breakfast - Eggs used for baking muffins

Number of eggs sold daily = Eggs remaining
Eggs sold daily value = Number of eggs sold daily * Price per egg at the market
= 9 * $2
= \boxed{\$18}

So Janet makes \boxed{$18$} every day at the farmers' market.
